subject: general
question: Garba folk dance belongs to which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Garba** is a popular folk dance of **Gujarat** and is performed during the **festival of Navratri.**
 
• It is a circular dance performed by **women **around a centrally placed **lamp or statue **of Goddess Durga.
 
• The dance is accompanied by **rhythmic clapping** and singing of traditional folk songs.
 
• The dance form has **gained popularity** not only in India but also in other parts of the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan** also have their own unique folk dance forms such as **Gondhal, Lavani, and Ghoomar **respectively.
